clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Wetlands, Mosshide Fen is held by the Mosshide gnolls. Its primitive camps lie far from the main trade roads, where travelers face danger.

Mosshide gnolls hold the tangled marsh of eastern Wetlands. Rough lean-tos and bone-strewn camps mark their territory. Gnawbone and other pack leaders command the tribe, which ambushes and devours travelers, scouts, and prospectors who enter its hunting grounds.
